answers.reason: The senate deals with the strategy of the whole university, while each member only takes part in the one place where their specific matters are decided.
The budget planning round handles central fund allocation, which is outside the single faculty-level forum where the full professor takes part.
Every member participates in only one body, and the full professor's primary place for faculty affairs is the faculty council rather than specialized committees.
As a holder of a chair in the faculty, the faculty council is the single body where the full professor's matters are decided.
Members do not sit in bodies that deal with other kinds of questions outside their single designated place.
The examination board handles individual student examination matters, which is separate from the single body where the full professor participates.
The internal research funding round is a specialized round for small grants, better matching junior researchers, while the full professor sits only in their one main faculty body.
Each member takes part in only one place, so the full professor does not sit in working groups for rewriting module descriptions.
Decisions about laboratory equipment are strictly separated from other matters, and the full professor only participates in one body.
Planning the orientation week for new students is outside the single decision-making body assigned to the full professor.
